description: Na₂LiFeCPO₇ crystallizes in the monoclinic Pc space group. There are four inequivalent Na sites. In the first Na site, Na is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to six O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.30-2.68 Å. In the second Na site, Na is bonded in a 7-coordinate geometry to seven O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.39-2.84 Å. In the third Na site, Na is bonded in a 7-coordinate geometry to seven O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.29-2.76 Å. In the fourth Na site, Na is bonded in a 7-coordinate geometry to seven O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.30-2.85 Å. There are two inequivalent Li sites. In the first Li site, Li is bonded to five O atoms to form distorted LiO₅ trigonal bipyramids that share corners with two FeO₆ octahedra, corners with three PO₄ tetrahedra, and  an edgeedge with one FeO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 64-88°. There are a spread of Li-O bond distances ranging from 2.16-2.46 Å. In the second Li site, Li is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to five O atoms. There are a spread of Li-O bond distances ranging from 2.12-2.61 Å. There are two inequivalent Fe sites. In the first Fe site, Fe is bonded to six O atoms to form distorted FeO₆ octahedra that share corners with four PO₄ tetrahedra,  a cornercorner with one LiO₅ trigonal bipyramid, and  an edgeedge with one LiO₅ trigonal bipyramid. There are a spread of Fe-O bond distances ranging from 2.07-2.42 Å. In the second Fe site, Fe is bonded to six O atoms to form distorted FeO₆ octahedra that share corners with four PO₄ tetrahedra and  a cornercorner with one LiO₅ trigonal bipyramid. There are a spread of Fe-O bond distances ranging from 2.10-2.37 Å. There are two inequivalent C sites. In the first C site, C is bonded in a trigonal planar geometry to three O atoms. There are a spread of C-O bond distances ranging from 1.29-1.31 Å. In the second C site, C is bonded in a trigonal planar geometry to three O atoms. There are a spread of C-O bond distances ranging from 1.29-1.31 Å. There are two inequivalent P sites. In the first P site, P is bonded to four O atoms to form PO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with four FeO₆ octahedra and corners with two equivalent LiO₅ trigonal bipyramids. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 43-59°. There are a spread of P-O bond distances ranging from 1.54-1.57 Å. In the second P site, P is bonded to four O atoms to form PO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with four FeO₆ octahedra and  a cornercorner with one LiO₅ trigonal bipyramid. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 42-56°. There are a spread of P-O bond distances ranging from 1.55-1.57 Å. There are fourteen inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to three Na, one Li, and one C atom. In the second O site, O is bonded in a 2-coordinate geometry to one Na, one Li, one Fe, and one C atom. In the third O site, O is bonded in a 1-coordinate geometry to one Na, two Li, one Fe, and one C atom. In the fourth O site, O is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to two Na, one Li, one Fe, and one P atom. In the fifth O site, O is bonded to two Na, one Fe, and one P atom to form distorted ONa₂FeP trigonal pyramids that share corners with two equivalent ONaLiFeP tetrahedra and  a cornercorner with one ONa₃FeC trigonal bipyramid. In the sixth O site, O is bonded to one Na, one Li, one Fe, and one P atom to form distorted ONaLiFeP tetrahedra that share  a cornercorner with one ONa₃FeC trigonal bipyramid and corners with two equivalent ONa₂FeP trigonal pyramids. In the seventh O site, O is bonded in a distorted rectangular see-saw-like geometry to one Na, one Li, one Fe, and one P atom. In the eighth O site, O is bonded in a rectangular see-saw-like geometry to two Na, one Fe, and one P atom. In the ninth O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to two Na, one Fe, and one P atom. In the tenth O site, O is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to two Na, one Li, one Fe, and one P atom. In the eleventh O site, O is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to two Na, one Li, one Fe, and one P atom. In the twelfth O site, O is bonded to three Na, one Fe, and one C atom to form distorted ONa₃FeC trigonal bipyramids that share corners with three ONaLiFeP tetrahedra and  a cornercorner with one ONa₂FeP trigonal pyramid. In the thirteenth O site, O is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to three Na, one Fe, and one C atom. In the fourteenth O site, O is bonded to two Na, one Li, and one C atom to form distorted corner-sharing ONa₂LiC tetrahedra.
